limits: Only twelve successful synthetic updates were timed; three earlier updates ended in a preserved metadata-serialization failure.
Synthetic content and repeated source episodes cannot establish learning effectiveness, calibration or actual-corpus runtime.
The projection intentionally repeats cold whole-call setup per update and per evaluation batch; this is a conservative sizing proxy, not a speed benchmark.

Actual fits clone640 rather than96 episodes and evaluation calls handle128 rather than32; these unmeasured scales are covered provisionally by explicit multiplier/allowance, not validated as a strict upper bound.
No real corpus, study initialization/order namespace or native simulator was consumed by this review.

prospective_sizing.assessment: The fixed 1800-second safety cap has ample measured engineering headroom. It remains a stop limit, not a guaranteed completion bound; no in-run extension or automatic retry.
prospective_sizing.generous_formula: 2 * combined proxy + 120 seconds for unmeasured outer/setup/hash/storage variation

scope: saved engineering artifacts and arithmetic only; no numerical rerun, efficacy or comparative speed claim
